answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each participant to submit a Groth16 proof that a bonded deposit exceeds a ferrous collateral threshold, binding identity to capital rather than a fable of reputation. Recursive aggregation over pasta curves lets validators verify thousands of these membership proofs in sub-second latency, so a jetty of attested stake gates entry. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
